ground_truth_method: Manual adversarial authorship from accepted WP2 trust boundaries and closed schema, followed by independent byte-offset, SHA-256, stable-identity, and replay-gap calculation.
identity_method: Four-byte signed big-endian UTF-8 length plus UTF-8 bytes for each ordered field; first 32 lowercase SHA-256 hex characters; ordinal length:value canonical sets.
known_limitations: Synthetic hostile strings demonstrate inert data handling but are not an exhaustive security test.
Deletion and unavailability are fixture-modeled state transitions, not filesystem deletion operations.
The package establishes no held-out, real-mod, safety, compatibility, or readiness verdict.
